req.title: Basic-auth rejects missing header
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent from a request to /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent. To achieve high mutation kill rate, I design: (1) a positive test confirming 200 with valid credentials (catches mutations that break the success path), (2) a negative test confirming 401 with no Authorization header at all (the primary requirement), (3) a boundary test confirming 401 when Authorization header is present but empty/malformed (catches mutations that weaken the auth check), (4) a decision-table test confirming 401 when wrong credentials are supplied (catches boolean-logic mutations in check_basic_auth), and (5) a state-transition test confirming the WWW-Authenticate header is present on 401 (catches mutations that suppress the challenge header). Each test asserts exact status codes and exact response body fields to maximize mutation detection.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_success_with_valid_credentials
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Valid username 'user' and password 'passwd' are used
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with correct Basic Authorization header
Inspect response status code and JSON body
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='user'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020 positive path: valid credentials yield 200
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd',
               headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'user'

def test_basic_auth_success_with_valid_credentials():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd',
                   headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'user'

tests.name: test_basic_auth_www_authenticate_header_on_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with no Authorization header
Inspect WWW-Authenticate header value for 'Basic' realm
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020 boundary: 401 must include proper WWW-Authenticate challenge; catches mutations that suppress header or change status code
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypasswd')
assert r.status_code == 401
www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
assert 'Basic' in www_auth
assert 'Fake Realm' in www_auth

def test_basic_auth_www_authenticate_header_on_401():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/myuser/mypasswd')
    assert r.status_code == 401
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert 'Basic' in www_auth
    assert 'Fake Realm' in www_auth
